verdict.rationale: Navan's pricing page claims its own "Unlimited policy and approval workflows", and its MCP docs say users can ask about approval flows and "who needs to approve it". That confirms a first-party approval-workflow capability, but nothing shows how deep it goes. missing for 10: documented multi-step chains (manager → budget owner → finance), approver delegation, escalation or reminders when approvers sit on requests, configuration docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can build multi-step approval chains — manager, budget owner, finance — with delegation and escalation when approvers sit on requests

citations.quote: Ask questions about policies, approval flows, and flag/decline reasons
understand why a transaction was flagged, who needs to approve it, and what policy applies.
